entries.title: Leviticus 26:1
segments: ¶Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up [any] image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I [am] the LORD your God. {standing...: or, pillar} {image of...: or, figured stone: Heb. a stone of picture}

words.text: unto it: for I [am] the LORD
. {standing...: or, pillar} {image of...: or, figured stone: Heb. a stone of picture}

entries.title: Leviticus 26:2
segments: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:3
segments: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

entries.title: Leviticus 26:4
segments: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:5
segments: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:6
segments: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make [you] afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land. {rid: Heb. cause to cease}

entries.title: Leviticus 26:7
segments: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:8
segments: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

words.text: of you shall put ten thousand

entries.title: Leviticus 26:9
segments: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

words.text: unto you, and make you fruitful

entries.title: Leviticus 26:10
segments: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:11
segments: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:12
segments: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:13
segments: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

words.text: , that ye should not be their bondmen

entries.title: Leviticus 26:14
segments: ¶But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

words.text: unto me, and will not do

entries.title: Leviticus 26:15
segments: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, [but] that ye break my covenant:

words.text: , so that ye will not do

entries.title: Leviticus 26:16
segments: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it. {over: Heb. upon}

words.text: this unto you; I will even appoint

entries.title: Leviticus 26:17
segments: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

words.text: against you, and ye shall be slain
over you; and ye shall flee

entries.title: Leviticus 26:18
segments: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

words.text: And if ye will not yet
unto me, then I will punish

entries.title: Leviticus 26:19
segments: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

entries.title: Leviticus 26:20
segments: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:21
segments: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins. {contrary...: or, at all adventures with me}

words.text: upon you according to your sins
. {contrary...: or, at all adventures with me}

entries.title: Leviticus 26:22
segments: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your [high] ways shall be desolate.

words.text: among you, which shall rob you of your children
, and make you few in number

entries.title: Leviticus 26:23
segments: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

words.text: And if ye will not be reformed
by me by these things, but will walk

entries.title: Leviticus 26:24
segments: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:25
segments: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of [my] covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

words.text: : and when ye are gathered together
you; and ye shall be delivered

entries.title: Leviticus 26:26
segments: [And] when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver [you] your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:27
segments: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

words.text: And if ye will not for all this

entries.title: Leviticus 26:28
segments: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:29
segments: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:30
segments: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:31
segments: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:32
segments: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:33
segments: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:34
segments: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye [be] in your enemies' land; [even] then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:35
segments: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:36
segments: And upon them that are left [alive] of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth. {shaken: Heb. driven}

words.text: And upon them that are left

entries.title: Leviticus 26:37
segments: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

words.text: : and ye shall have no power to stand

entries.title: Leviticus 26:38
segments: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:39
segments: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:40
segments: ¶If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

words.text: against me, and that also they have walked

entries.title: Leviticus 26:41
segments: And [that] I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

words.text: of the punishment of their iniquity

entries.title: Leviticus 26:42
segments: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

entries.title: Leviticus 26:43
segments: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

words.text: without them: and they shall accept
of the punishment of their iniquity

entries.title: Leviticus 26:44
segments: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I [am] the LORD their God.

words.text: , I will not cast them away
with them: for I [am] the LORD

entries.title: Leviticus 26:45
segments: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I [am] the LORD.

words.text: But I will for their sakes remember
, that I might be their God

entries.title: Leviticus 26:46
segments: These [are] the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
